About.title: About me
About.subtitle: Get to know me a little better

bio.p1: I've been passionate about technology from an early age, and for the past {years} years, I've dedicated myself to the world of programming and software development.
bio.p2: I have experience developing end-to-end web applications, always prioritizing quality, security, and code maintainability.
bio.p3: Currently, I work as a Full Stack Developer, participating in system building, technical decisions, refactoring, and application evolution. I enjoy solving complex problems, proposing solutions, and finding ways to make systems simpler, more efficient, and ready to scale.
bio.p4: In the coming years, I want to keep growing technically, contribute to company growth through products that bring value to users, and at the same time, turn my own ideas into products that make an impact in the market.
